title: Preventive Shield analysis.timing
description: Stage timings from POST /api/check. First-party only — no third-party reputation fields. Aligned with OpenAPI Preventive Shield check API version 1.5 (ambiguousProbeStatus required).

probeHeadFailed.description: True when the first hop HEAD failed or was rejected and GET was used (or probe skipped).

headSkipped.description: True when HEAD was skipped intentionally (server head-skip cache or client skipHeadHosts).

ambiguousProbeStatus.description: True when live HTTP status was 403, 429, or 503 (bot block / throttle). Does not escalate risk level.
